title: OpenAI launches new Codex tools for white-collar work
description: OpenAI is getting serious about courting enterprise users. On Tuesday, the AI lab released a new set of capabilities for Codex, meant to expand the agentic tool’s uses in the workplace. Together with the new tools, the company released an internal report on how Codex is being used for knowledge work, finding its uses go […]
summary_cn: OpenAI发布Codex新工具集，旨在将AI代理能力扩展到企业白领工作场景（如文档处理、数据分析等），并配套发布内部使用报告。此举标志着OpenAI从代码助手向通用企业助手的战略转型，通过增强Codex的自主任务执行能力，降低企业AI应用门槛，提升白领工作效率。产品创新点在于将代码能力与自然语言交互结合，实现更复杂的业务流程自动化。
